granite-speech5-quality.status: architecture-guided and smoke-validated as a group; individual exclusions have not been ablated
reasons: encoder.input_linear is the sole learned boundary from stacked log-mel and delta features into all 16 encoder blocks.
encoder.out is shared by the midpoint self-conditioning logits and the final CTC vocabulary logits.
encoder.out_mid maps the midpoint 16,384-way token distribution back into hidden space, so its error is fed through the remaining encoder blocks.
granite-speech5-quality.validation: Uniform Q4 corrupted the controlled transcript. Selective Q4 and Q8 matched the BF16 transcript exactly on the fixed 8.608-second clip and passed the MLX Audio HTTP endpoint. On an Apple M4 MacBook Air with 24 GB RAM, five warm runs after one warm-up had median model-inference times of 0.0599 seconds for BF16, 0.0637 seconds for Q4, and 0.0635 seconds for Q8 (143.8x, 135.1x, and 135.5x real time).

audio8-quality.status: conservative architecture-guided candidate; real-audio validation and per-group ablation are pending
reasons: model.embeddings is both the text/semantic input table and the tied full-vocabulary semantic output head.
model.codebook_embeddings injects the prompt and previously generated acoustic codebooks into the slow autoregressive state.
model.fast_embeddings and model.fast_output are the input/output boundaries for residual-codebook selection.
codec contains the learned acoustic encoder, quantizers, and waveform decoder; it stays at source precision until objective and listening tests justify narrower exclusions.
audio8-quality.validation: Pending BF16/Q4/Q8 waveform, non-silence, round-trip ASR, and listening comparisons. This profile must not be described as quality-validated yet.
